meta.title: Betty Teklemariam — intercultural advisor and mediator
meta.description: Betty Teklemariam is an intercultural advisor and mediator between Eritrean communities and Dutch organisations: guidance, cultural mediation, cultural translation and workshops.

hero.intro: I help municipalities, researchers, community organisations and newcomers understand each other better and move forward together.

features.heading: Why intercultural advice and mediation?
features.intro: There's often a deep, invisible gap between institutions and newcomers. I help make these gaps visible, discussable and bridgeable.

items.title: Cultural differences
items.desc: Understanding of deep-rooted norms and values that shape interactions.

items.title: Language barriers
items.desc: Bridging language differences to prevent miscommunication.

items.title: Mistrust
items.desc: Building a safe foundation for open communication and trust.

services.heading: My Services
services.intro: Practical support for organisations that want to work effectively with Eritrean communities.

items.title: Guidance
items.desc: Personal support in navigating complex cultural landscapes and social integration.

items.title: Cultural Mediation
items.desc: Bridging differences in communication and expectations between diverse groups and institutions.

items.title: Interpreting & Translation
items.desc: Support for conversations and communication, spoken and written, with an eye for both language and cultural context.

items.title: Workshops & Training
items.desc: Interactive sessions focused on awareness, inclusion and effectively engaging with cultural diversity.

about.heading: About me
about.intro: Bet-El Teklemariam, intercultural advisor, mediator, trainer and social pedagogue.
about.bodyText: I fled Eritrea at a young age. I know from experience how much it means when someone understands you in a place that's new to you. I combine that experience with more than 26 years of work in guidance, youth care, psychiatry and the social domain.

qualities.title: People-focused
qualities.desc: Bringing calm to conversations where trust and context matter most.

qualities.title: Practical
qualities.desc: Thinking along with professionals about what helps directly in practice.

qualities.title: Culturally sensitive
qualities.desc: Weighing language, family relationships and background into every piece of advice.

testimonials.heading: What clients say
testimonials.intro: Experiences from organisations that have worked with Betty

items.text: Bet-El is an honest and highly reliable professional who plays an important role as a cultural connector. She consistently keeps her commitments, is flexible and often delivers more than expected.
items.name: Monique Haveman
items.sub: Mix Support, Care and Quality Advisor

items.text: Betty is incredibly reliable. You can feel that she does her work with love and dedication. Like no one else, she has an eye for the obstacles refugees face.
